name: Oni
description: A hulking demonic creature with horns and fangs. Often serves as a boss or enforcer of the Yomi realm.

name: Bandit
description: Desperate criminals roaming the roads and forests of Kage no Shima.

name: Yuki-Onna
description: A ghostly woman of snow and sorrow. Her touch chills the soul.

name: Skeleton Rōnin
description: Fallen warriors cursed to walk again. Their bones creak with vengeance.

name: Tengu
description: Winged mountain spirits with long noses and martial prowess.

name: Jorogumo
description: A spider demon that takes the form of a beautiful woman to lure prey.

name: Ryu
description: A celestial dragon of immense power and wisdom. Rare and divine.

name: Blood Witch
description: A cursed sorceress who manipulates blood for forbidden spells.
